name: smwgraphics-bonus-level-graphics
title: Bonus Level Graphics
description:
Based on Cirvante's rip of "Mario and Wario".

This set was made/edited for one of my hacks. It includes a whole lot of tiles to build up good bonus levels. It's compatible with the original foreground of the Switch palaces. But you'll have to make a new background. (Suggestion: the last four tiles of the included map16 page)

Anyways, this is my first submitted graphics. And I think it meets the standards.

(Uses a BG1 instead of FG3)
